## Before you submit

GitHub issues are public. Do not include private repository details, source code, task prompts,
agent output, patches, logs, credentials, or provider account details.

- For a reproducible problem, use the [bug report form](https://github.com/DreyzeDev/agent-arena/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- For a proposed improvement, use the [feature request form](https://github.com/DreyzeDev/agent-arena/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- For setup or first-run feedback, use the [first-run feedback form](https://github.com/DreyzeDev/agent-arena/issues/new?template=first-run-feedback.yml).

## What should we know?

If none of those forms fit, describe the question or issue here. Include only details that are safe
to make public.
